name: Advances in Additive Manufacturing
description: Introduction to additive manufacturing (AM); data preparation, different energy sources for AM, feedstocks for AM, process parameters in AM, advances in different AM processes- extrusion, vat-photopolymerization, powder bed fusion, directed energy deposition, sheet lamination, binder jetting, material jetting, wire-arc additive manufacturing, hybrid additive manufacturing, support structures and their classification, reverse engineering, post-processing techniques in AM, special properties of AM parts, process monitoring in AM process and its significance, laser beam shaping and additive manufacturing, AI/ML in additive manufacturing, path planning in AM, generative design and topology optimization in AM, sustainability and security aspects in AM processes. Students will be given hands-on exposure to different additive manufacturing processing modalities.
